targets.notes: PO item, mirroring sales_order_lines/VBAP conventions: EBELP follows SAP numbering (Line_Number x10), pricing source columns are dropped as condition-driven, and quantities are carried as-is.

fields.sap_description: Purchasing Document Number (staging key, must match the header)

targets.notes: One schedule line per item (ETENR constant '1') -- the source has a single Expected_Date per line, so there is nothing to fan out into multiple schedule lines. Quantity_Received is carried here as WEMNG, mirroring how sales lines treat delivered quantity as document-flow data: in a real load it would be derived from goods-receipt documents (MSEG) instead of trusted from the source.

fields.sap_description: Quantity Delivered (from legacy Quantity_Received; a real load derives this from MSEG goods movements)

dropped_fields.reason: SAP's own key is EKPO-EBELP; kept only as an informal source row identifier, not loaded
denormalized in the source -- EKPO has no company code field, it is inherited from the header (EKKO-BUKRS)
pricing is fully condition-driven in MM (KONV/PRCD_ELEMENTS), no flat EKPO field -- same treatment as VBAP
item-level discount condition record (KONV/PRCD_ELEMENTS), not a stored field
tax condition record result (KONV/PRCD_ELEMENTS), not a stored field -- the tax CODE is carried via EKPO-MWSKZ

not_migrated_fields.reason: captured automatically as the creating SAP user
